title: Multimodal split learning under missing modalities
summary: Making multimodal transformers robust when inputs are missing.
description:
Investigating the lack of robustness of multimodal transformer models under missing modalities in a split-learning setup, where the model is divided between client devices and a server.

I independently designed a Transformer framework to evaluate alternative approaches, such as fusion and imputation techniques, to improve accuracy.
